scope: Sampled, usable-light shoreline-contact pixels only; no whole-morning or whole-Montrose inference

roi.rule: Only demonstrably resolved waterline/contact pixels inside these rectangles may be annotated. Exclude pier deck, bulkhead, lawns, open water and obstructed/unresolved pixels. The rectangles are review bounds, not a validated continuous beach footprint. Same exact annotated subsegment mask and physical landmarks required on both sides.

matching_tolerances.shoreline_cell_or_visible_scope: Identical validated physical subsegment and mask; zero corridor-label substitution

predawn_clock_window.nominal_or_unknown_timing: UNKNOWN until actual frame clock bounds independently reconstructed
predawn_clock_window.event_occurrence: Direct Jubilee biology must be documented in the exact ROI at the event-side sampled frame times. Onset, ending and inter-burst duration stay UNKNOWN unless observed.

tide_phase.rule: Same source, station, method, datum, QC and phase class. Use source-derived time relative to the same type of turning point. Prediction can match prediction but never observed water level. Missing either side blocks pairing.

current_or_transport_phase_when_availabl.both_available: Same source/site, Earth-frame reference, depth, method and accepted QC

matching_tolerances.private_camera_availability: Same expected/fresh camera IDs, site groups, illumination category, moderate-or-high biological detectability, obstruction state and scheduled three-shot sampling. Extra event-driven media may confirm occurrence but cannot substitute for comparator sampling.
matching_tolerances.public_camera_availability: Same availability and geometric scope signature; both unavailable permitted when explicitly documented
matching_tolerances.social_or_human_observation_availability: Same search/check effort and availability signature; both unavailable permitted. Social silence, absent people/lights and failed searches never imply biological absence.

review_requirements: Reopen all retained hashes and independently review pixels on both sides
Document reviewers, reviewed_at, available_at, exact masks/landmarks and evidence references
Positive: directly observed Jubilee-class shoreline crowding/emergence, not ordinary fish, catches from elsewhere, people or lights alone
Negative: adequate same-class detectability and no event evidence in exactly the sampled ROI; darkness and gaps remain UNKNOWN
Episode/date block samples; repeated bursts are correlated, not independent controls
An initial qualifying pair is exploratory; no sensitivity, specificity or calibration claim follows from one pair
tolerance_rationale: Conservative exploratory limits fixed before pair scoring: 30 days constrains season, one existing dawn cadence constrains clock, actual three-shot sampling constrains observation effort, and same tide phase within 30 minutes constrains transport context. Direction/speed and 5-pixel registration limits are prespecified engineering screens, not empirically validated ecological equivalence. Do not relax them after seeing results; a new design needs a new version and separate evaluation.
